fail_closed_leaks.sql: SELECT (a0.t0_id % 2), CAST(MIN(a0.x) AS VARCHAR) AS u, SUM((LEAST(0.00, 0.00) * 100000000000000000000000000000000000000001)) AS id FROM t1 a0, t0 a1 WHERE a0.t0_id <= a1.id GROUP BY (a0.t0_id % 2) ORDER BY MIN(a0.x) ASC

SELECT DISTINCT a1.u, (SELECT SUM((s1.x * DECIMAL '1.25'::FLOAT)) FROM t2 s1), y, (SELECT COUNT(FALSE) FROM t0 s2) AS c2 FROM t2 a0 JOIN t1 a1 ON a0.n = a1.amt WHERE a0.w IS NULL AND a1.flag > CAST('-0.0' AS DOUBLE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t3 s0 WHERE s0.s = a0.n) ORDER BY y

SELECT AVG((a0.id * 1e0)), CAST(a0.x AS VARCHAR) FROM t2 a0 JOIN t0 a1 ON a0.id <> a1.id WHERE (a1.s IS NULL OR a0.id = 12) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t0 s0 WHERE s0.name = a1.amt AND s0.v IS NOT NULL) AND a1.amt = 'b' GROUP BY CAST(a0.x AS VARCHAR) ORDER BY AVG((a0.id * 1e0)) DESC NULLS FIRST, CAST(a0.x AS VARCHAR), (2)

SELECT CASE WHEN AVG((a0.id * INTEGER '2'::DOUBLE)) > 1 THEN 'hi' ELSE 'lo' END, t0_id, COALESCE(COUNT(a0.t0_id), 2) AS id FROM t1 a0 JOIN t2 a1 ON a0.x = a1.d WHERE a0.t0_id = 12 AND (flag = a0.v OR a1.s = a0.t0_id) GROUP BY 2 LIMIT 3
SELECT (a0.v % 2), a0.id, (1 / SUM((1.00 * 1e-1))) FROM t0 a0 WHERE (a0.v <= -1 OR a0.v = a0.y) AND a0.id = v GROUP BY (a0.v % 2), a0.id HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ORDER BY 3 DESC NULLS LAST, (a0.v % 2)
SELECT AVG((a0.id * 1e-1)) AS s, a1.code FROM t2 a0, t4 a1 WHERE a0.flag = a0.w AND (a0.name = FALSE OR a1.code NOT IN ('ab', 'ba')) GROUP BY a1.code ORDER BY MAX(a1.v) DESC, 2 DESC LIMIT 0

SELECT ROUND(COUNT(-x::DECIMAL(10,2)), 1), LOWER(a0.u) FROM t1 a0 JOIN t0 a1 ON a0.t0_id = a1.id WHERE a0.id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a1.flag, LOWER(a0.u) HAVING SUM((a1.id * 100000000000000000000000000000000000000001)) <> CAST('0.0' AS DOUBLE) AND LOWER(a0.u) IS NULL ORDER BY (2) DESC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 5

SELECT (AVG((a1.x * 0.1000000000000000000000000000000000000001)) + 1), a0.d, a1.x FROM t2 a0 JOIN t0 a1 ON a0.id <> a1.id WHERE a0.amt IS NOT NULL AND a1.id NOT IN (SELECT s0.id FROM t0 s0 WHERE s0.x IN (2.00, 0.00)) GROUP BY a0.d, a1.x ORDER BY 3 ASC NULLS FIRST, +3 NULLS LAST LIMIT 2
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT 1.25), SUM((POSITION('a' IN a1.w) * BIGINT '3'::REAL)) AS c1 FROM t4 a0 CROSS JOIN t4 a1 WHERE a0.id <> 10 AND a0.w IS NULL

SELECT (1 / SUM(COALESCE(a0.n, 0))) AS "Mixed Case", a1.name, SUM((a2.w * INTEGER '2'::DOUBLE)) AS t2_id FROM t3 a0 JOIN t1 a1 ON a0.t2_id = a1.n, t0 a2 WHERE a1.id = a2.flag AND a1.s = 'b' AND REGEXP_MATCHES(a2.u, '^a') = FALSE GROUP BY a1.name, a2.flag HAVING a2.flag = 8 ORDER BY "Mixed Case" ASC NULLS LAST, "T2_ID" DESC

SELECT MAX((a1.s SIMILAR TO 'a%')) AS u, a0.name, SUM((a1.w * DECIMAL '1.25'::FLOAT)) AS "ID" FROM t3 a0 JOIN t0 a1 ON a0.flag = a1.s WHERE a1.n = 8 GROUP BY 2 HAVING COUNT(*) > 2 ORDER BY MIN((FALSE IS FALSE)) DESC NULLS LAST, "U" LIMIT 5

SELECT AVG((a0.flag * DECIMAL '0.1'::DOUBLE)), a1.name, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT (a0.code <= a0.x)) > 1 THEN 'hi' ELSE 'lo' END FROM t1 a0, t3 a1 WHERE a0.n = a1.v AND a1.id BETWEEN 0 AND 3 GROUP BY 2

SELECT SUM((a2.flag * DECIMAL '0.1'::DOUBLE)) FROM t3 a0 JOIN t1 a1 ON a0.name = a1.x JOIN t1 a2 ON a1.code = a2.x WHERE a0.name >= 'B' AND a0.id < (SELECT COUNT(ROUND(s0.flag, 0)) FROM t1 s0 WHERE s0.code = a1.x) LIMIT 1
SELECT v, SUM((a0.w * BIGINT '3'::REAL)) FROM t1 a0 JOIN t3 a1 ON a0.id = a1.t1_id WHERE a1.t1_id = 6 GROUP BY v HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 AND v IS NULL ORDER BY v ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT AVG((CAST(a0.x AS INTEGER) * INTEGER '2'::DOUBLE)) FROM t0 a0 WHERE (a0.id = a0.x OR a0.x > CAST('-0.0' AS DOUBLE)) LIMIT 5

SELECT DISTINCT a1.amt, a1.id FROM t3 a0 JOIN t3 a1 ON a0.s = a1.y JOIN t1 a2 ON a0.t0_id = a2.id WHERE a0.id = 3 AND a2.s = a1.t1_id AND (SELECT SUM((-1 * INTEGER '2'::DOUBLE)) FROM t2 s0 WHERE s0.x = a1.t1_id) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1 DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT CASE WHEN AVG((COALESCE(a1.s, 1.25) * DECIMAL '1.25'::FLOAT)) > 1 THEN 'hi' ELSE 'lo' END, COALESCE(MAX((FALSE OR FALSE)), FALSE), COUNT(DISTINCT TRUE) FROM t4 a0 JOIN t0 a1 ON a0.id = a1.n
SELECT MAX(a1.s), SUM((1.25 * BIGINT '3'::REAL)) FILTER (WHERE -1.50 = 1.25) AS "S" FROM t2 a0 JOIN t3 a1 ON a0.id = a1.id LIMIT 0
SELECT SUM((CAST(1.00 AS INTEGER) * INTEGER '2'::DOUBLE)) AS "ID" FROM t1 a0 WHERE t0_id IS NULL AND a0.id NOT IN (1, 1) AND a0.s NOT IN (SELECT s0.name FROM t4 s0) HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 LIMIT 0

SELECT a0.code, a0.name, a0.n, a1.v FROM t0 a0 JOIN t1 a1 ON a0.name = a1.n WHERE a1.flag >= (SELECT SUM((s0.v * 100000000000000000000000000000000000000001)) FROM t1 s0 WHERE s0.flag = a0.flag) ORDER BY (SELECT MIN('a') FROM t1 s1 WHERE s1.s = a1.s) NULLS LAST
SELECT (SUM((a1.amt * DECIMAL '0.1'::DOUBLE)) + 1) FROM t0 a0, t0 a1 WHERE a0.v < a1.v AND a1.s = a1.x

SELECT (SELECT AVG((0.50 * INTEGER '2'::DOUBLE)) FROM t0 s1 WHERE s1.w = a0.w) FROM t0 a0 JOIN t1 a1 ON a0.x = a1.d WHERE a0.id <= (SELECT s0.id FROM t0 s0 WHERE s0.id = a1.n) AND a1.u NOT IN ('ba', 'aB')
SELECT AVG((2 * 3e-1)) AS "W", COUNT(DISTINCT a1.id) AS "FLAG", MIN(IFNULL(a0.flag, 'z')) FROM t3 a0 JOIN t2 a1 ON a0.t2_id = a1.v WHERE NULLIF(1.25, 1.00) = 1.25

SELECT SUM((LEAST(-1.50, 0.50) * DECIMAL '1.25'::FLOAT)), MAX(CAST(a2.name AS DECIMAL(10,2))) FROM t3 a0, t3 a1 JOIN t3 a2 ON a1.d >= a2.id WHERE a0.id = a1.d AND (SELECT s0.amt FROM t1 s0 WHERE s0.code = a2.s) IS NOT NULL AND a0.t2_id = a0.s AND a0.s = '01'
SELECT COUNT(LEAST(1.00, -1.50)), (COUNT(*) + 1), SUM((1.25 * 0.1000000000000000000000000000000000000001)) FROM t1 a0 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t0 s0 WHERE s0.id = a0.id)
SELECT (SELECT SUM((y * DECIMAL '0.1'::DOUBLE)) FROM t1 s0 WHERE s0.id = a0.t1_id) AS "T1_ID", a0.t1_id AS "C2", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t1 s1), a0.x FROM t2 a0 WHERE a0.n = a0.s

SELECT COUNT(*), a0.x, LOWER(a0.x), (1 / SUM(((1.25 * 0) * DECIMAL '0.1'::DOUBLE)) FILTER (WHERE a1.id = a0.w)) AS d FROM t3 a0 CROSS JOIN t1 a1 WHERE a0.d IN (SELECT s0.d FROM t0 s0 WHERE s0.x = s0.n) GROUP BY a0.x ORDER BY a0.x
SELECT * EXCLUDE (id) FROM t4 a0 WHERE a0.y = (SELECT SUM((NULLIF(d, 0.00) * DECIMAL '0.1'::DOUBLE)) FROM t1 s0 WHERE s0.s = a0.s) ORDER BY a0.id DESC, a0.s DESC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 0 OFFSET 1
SELECT MIN(n), YEAR(a0.amt), (1 / AVG((w * 0.1000000000000000000000000000000000000001))), YEAR(a1.y) FROM t3 a0 CROSS JOIN t1 a1 GROUP BY YEAR(a1.y), YEAR(a0.amt) ORDER BY YEAR(a1.y) LIMIT 5

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT LN(ABS(10.00) + 1)), SUM((EXTRACT(YEAR FROM amt) * DECIMAL '0.1'::DOUBLE)) FROM t3 a0 WHERE a0.x <= 8 GROUP BY a0.id, (a0.id % 2) HAVING MIN(0.00) >= 10.00 AND (a0.id % 2) IS NULL ORDER BY (1) LIMIT 5 OFFSET 2

SELECT (1 / SUM((2.00 * DECIMAL '1.25'::FLOAT))), AVG(CAST(2.00 AS INTEGER)), a0.v FROM t2 a0 WHERE a0.w = a0.id GROUP BY a0.v, a0.id ORDER BY a0.v NULLS FIRST, (1 / SUM((2.00 * DECIMAL '1.25'::FLOAT))) DESC NULLS FIRST

SELECT a0.amt, COALESCE(CASE WHEN a0.amt THEN CAST('1.5' AS DOUBLE) ELSE a0.id END, CAST('-0.0' AS DOUBLE)) AS c4 FROM t0 a0 WHERE a0.n IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (SELECT SUM((s1.id * DECIMAL '1.25'::FLOAT)) FROM t0 s1 WHERE s1.name = a0.x) DESC LIMIT 2 OFFSET 2

SELECT a0.id, a0.w AS c4, x FROM t0 a0 WHERE a0.amt BETWEEN 8 AND 0 ORDER BY (SELECT AVG((n * DECIMAL '0.1'::DOUBLE)) FILTER (WHERE id = 5) FROM t3 s0 WHERE s0.n = a0.n) DESC NULLS LAST, a0.id ASC, (2) ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 3
SELECT CAST(AVG((NULLIF(0.50, -1.50) * INTEGER '2'::DOUBLE)) AS VARCHAR), a0.y FROM t3 a0 WHERE id = 2 AND y NOT IN (0, 5) GROUP BY a0.y

SELECT COUNT(a0.flag), (a0.n % 2), MAX((CAST('0.0' AS DOUBLE) IS NOT NULL)) FROM t1 a0 GROUP BY CAST(a0.flag AS INTEGER), 2 HAVING CAST(a0.flag AS INTEGER) IS NULL AND (a0.n % 2) IS NULL ORDER BY SUM((LENGTH('b ') * 0.1000000000000000000000000000000000000001)) ASC
SELECT id AS "C2", COALESCE(SUM((ROUND(a0.x) * INTEGER '2'::DOUBLE)), CAST('1.5' AS DOUBLE)), a0.x AS "T0_ID" FROM t1 a0 GROUP BY 1, 3 ORDER BY a0.x ASC LIMIT 0

SELECT SUBSTRING(a0.amt, 1, 1), AVG((LENGTH(a0.u) * INTEGER '2'::DOUBLE)) FILTER (WHERE a0.u <= 'ba') FROM t2 a0 WHERE a0.u = a0.w AND a0.amt = '1' AND a0.name = 'b' GROUP BY SUBSTRING(a0.amt, 1, 1) ORDER BY MAX(CAST('0.0' AS DOUBLE)) ASC

SELECT MIN((0.50 - 0.50)) FILTER (WHERE a2.code IS NOT NULL), COALESCE(COUNT(*), -1) FROM t0 a0 JOIN t2 a1 ON a0.id = a1.d, t1 a2 WHERE a0.flag = a2.v ORDER BY AVG((FLOOR(10.00) * DECIMAL '1.25'::FLOAT)) ASC
SELECT COUNT(*), SUM((GREATEST(1.25, 0.00) * 100000000000000000000000000000000000000001)) FROM t1 a0 JOIN t0 a1 ON a0.name = a1.y WHERE SUBSTR(a0.v, 2) = ''
SELECT a0.d, SUM((a0.d * DECIMAL '0.1'::DOUBLE)) FROM t3 a0 WHERE a0.amt BETWEEN '01' AND '01' GROUP BY a0.d ORDER BY MIN(d) DESC, COUNT(a0.flag) DESC NULLS LAST, (1) NULLS LAST LIMIT 3
SELECT (NOT a1.y), SUM((-1 * 1e-1)) FROM t3 a0, t3 a1 WHERE a0.id = a1.id GROUP BY 1 HAVING (NOT a1.y) IS NULL AND (NOT a1.y) = FALSE ORDER BY SUM((-1 * 1e-1)), SUM((-1 * 1e-1)) DESC

SELECT a0.name, NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t0 s0 WHERE s0.u = a0.u), a1.x FROM t0 a0 JOIN t1 a1 ON a0.flag = a1.s WHERE a0.s IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (SELECT SUM((COALESCE(-1.50, 0.50) * BIGINT '3'::REAL)) FROM t2 s1 WHERE s1.s = a0.d) DESC NULLS FIRST, SUBSTRING(a0.x FROM 2 FOR 1) DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN TRUE THEN a0.name ELSE a0.name END), 2.00) AS x, AVG((a0.name * BIGINT '3'::REAL)) FROM t0 a0 WHERE a0.u > 'ba'

SELECT CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN a0.n THEN 'ab' ELSE a0.s END) AS VARCHAR), SUM((0 * DECIMAL '0.1'::DOUBLE)) FROM t2 a0 JOIN t0 a1 ON a0.id = a1.id WHERE a1.s NOT IN (SELECT s0.flag FROM t2 s0 WHERE (2.00 ^ 2) = CAST('-0.0' AS DOUBLE)) AND a0.flag NOT IN ('', 'ba') GROUP BY a0.v ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a0.w) NULLS LAST

SELECT (SELECT SUM((CASE WHEN FALSE THEN 0.00 ELSE -1.50 END * BIGINT '3'::REAL)) FILTER (WHERE s0.y = 'a') FROM t3 s0 WHERE s0.y = a0.s) FROM t3 a0 WHERE 0.50 = 10.00 AND a0.name <> '1' AND a0.name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d) FROM t4 s1 WHERE s1.name = a0.t1_id) NULLS LAST
SELECT AVG((COALESCE(3, 1) * INTEGER '2'::DOUBLE)), COALESCE(SUM(a0.amt), -1.50) FROM t0 a0 JOIN t3 a1 ON a0.id = a1.t2_id
SELECT a0.name FROM t4 a0 JOIN t0 a1 ON a0.t3_id > a1.x WHERE a1.x IS NULL AND a0.t3_id = 4 AND a0.id IS NULL ORDER BY (1), (SELECT AVG((s0.id * 1e-1)) FROM t4 s0), a0.t3_id DESC NULLS FIRST
SELECT MAX(0.50), MIN(LEFT(a0.d, 1)) AS "FLAG", (SUM((a0.id * INTEGER '2'::DOUBLE)) + 1) FROM t2 a0 WHERE a0.d NOT IN ('1', 'b ')
SELECT AVG((0.50 * INTEGER '2'::DOUBLE)) FROM t2 a0 WHERE a0.id = a0.d AND a0.id = 1 AND a0.y = 'b ' LIMIT 5
